subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below :
stimulus: Independence went the war. No nation joined to the battlefield to save the country. Our war of independence is it without struggle. People of all walks of life took place in 1971. They can achieve the birthright of a man.
guide_solution: (a) Independence is the birthright of a man. (b) No nation can achieve it without struggle. (c) Our war of independence took place in 1971. (d) People of all walks of life joined the war. (e) They went to the battlefield to save the country.
